properties.name: valueMissingLabel
properties.default: 'Please check this box if you want to proceed.'
properties.defaultValue: Please check this box if you want to proceed.
properties.description:
Localized constraint-validation message shown when `required` is unmet.

A prop rather than a hardcoded string, matching md-time-picker's
`value-missing-label`: components stay i18n-engine-agnostic and the
consumer localizes through its own dictionary. Native inputs get their
message from the browser's locale for free; a form-associated custom
element supplies its own, so leaving this hardcoded would ship an
English-only form to every locale.

properties.name: error
properties.description: Show the supporting line in the error colour.

properties.name: errorText
properties.description:
Supporting / error message shown beneath the control.

A checkbox previously had nowhere to put a message, so a failed `required`
could only surface as the browser's own validation balloon — visually
unrelated to the field, and gone the moment you click away. This gives it
the same inline supporting line md-text-field has.

The host is a fixed-size touch target, so the line is positioned OUT of
that box rather than laid out inside it; see the CSS for why that cannot
simply be a flex child.

properties.name: supportingText
properties.description: Supporting text shown when there is no error.

properties.name: indeterminate
properties.description: Whether the checkbox is in the indeterminate (mixed) state

properties.name: softDisabled
properties.description: Soft-disabled: disabled visuals but remains focusable for discoverability

properties.name: required
properties.description: Whether the checkbox is required in a form

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Checkbox
description: Select none, one, or many from a related set. Tri-state (checked / unchecked / indeterminate), form-associated via ElementInternals, with the full constraint-validation API and its own supporting/error line.

notes: Dedicated native checkbox: all twelve properties (indeterminate, error/errorText, supportingText, density 0…−4), mdChange and mdValidityChange, fourteen appearance hooks and five typed part targets.

Methods through AWCSelectionControlController: getValidity/checkValidity/reportValidity/setCustomValidity follow the source's constraint validation; reportValidity() shows the message in the supporting line and focuses the checkbox.

Click toggles (indeterminate → checked), Space once per press with the pressed pulse and a centred ripple, Enter inert; soft disabled stays focusable; the native form resets checked and indeterminate without events.
macOS SwiftUI/AppKit and Android emulator renderers are verified against the Chrome oracles; iOS runs through the simulator harness; VoiceOver/TalkBack execution remains unverified.
